parts.label: b
hints: The probability that a vehicle does not exceed 57 km/h is $1 - 0.0668 = 0.9332$.
The event 'at least one exceeds 57' is $1 - P(\text{none exceed}) = 1 - (0.9332)^n$. We require $1 - (0.9332)^n > 0.90$.
Rearrange to $(0.9332)^n < 0.10$, take natural logarithms (remembering that $\ln(0.9332) < 0$ flips the inequality sign), and find the smallest integer $n$.

walkthrough.text:
Express 'at least one vehicle exceeds 57 km/h' via the complement of none exceeding:
$$1 - (1 - 0.0668)^n > 0.90 \implies 1 - (0.9332)^n > 0.90 \implies (0.9332)^n < 0.10$$

Take natural logarithms of both sides and reverse the inequality since $\ln(0.9332) < 0$:
$$n \ln(0.9332) < \ln(0.10) \implies n > \frac{\ln(0.10)}{\ln(0.9332)}$$

Calculate the numerical quotient and round up to the smallest integer:
$$\frac{\ln(0.10)}{\ln(0.9332)} = \frac{-2.302585}{-0.069137} = 33.305 \implies n = 34$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Set up the inequality for at least one success:
$$1 - (0.9332)^n > 0.90 \iff (0.9332)^n < 0.10$$

Apply logarithms and divide by a negative quantity, flipping the sign:
$$n > \frac{\ln(0.10)}{\ln(0.9332)} = \frac{-2.3026}{-0.06914}$$

Determine the least integer boundary:
$$n > 33.305 \implies n = 34$$

ai_rubric.observable: Apply logarithms and reverse the inequality: n > ln(0.10) / ln(0.9332).

Sum the terms to evaluate the total probability:
$$0.3598 + 0.4191 = 0.7789 \text{ (or } 0.779\text{)}$$

ai_rubric.observable: Calculate the probability that all four lie in the interval: (0.7745)^4 = 0.3598.
